title: LightSim project history (one line of history.jsonl in a project's backups folder)
description: Format version 1. Generated from LightSim's data models; the specification is docs/spec/README.md. Licence: a draft waiting for the owner's decision, see docs/spec/README.md.

Change.description:
One value that changed. ``old`` is left out when the value was added,
``new`` when it was removed; ``at`` is the place a new list item took.

path.description: keys of objects, and {"id": ...} for an item of a list of objects with ids
path.title: Path

Change.title: Change

t.description: when, in milliseconds since 1 January 1970, UTC
t.title: T

tool.description: save (the app), model_edit (MCP), lightsim edit (command line), undo, restore
tool.title: Tool

client.description: the AI app, as it names itself
client.title: Client

session.description: the agent's session: one MCP connection, or the command line's LIGHTSIM_SESSION
session.title: Session

from.description: the file's revision before (None: a new file)
from.title: From

diff.description: None: not known (a new file, or one that could not be read)
diff.title: Diff

undoes.description: ids of the entries it undid
undoes.title: Undoes
